evidence.note: Large dark serif title over two lines with a bold blue kicker; high contrast on plain white, no texture or grain.
Three bullets in generous dark sans type with thick blue dash markers.
Three large white cards with soft drop shadows and big dark labels; the connector arrows are thin mid-grey lines (about 2 px) with small arrowheads.
Card labels and bullets stay readable; the thin grey arrows and the faint shadow card edges are the weakest marks but still visible.
Section nav and Notes chip are small grey text, but this is deck chrome, not slide content.

rationale: The slide is built from big soft cards and generous high-contrast type on flat white, with no texture, grain or grid lines. The thin grey connector arrows and shadow-only card edges are the most compression-fragile marks, but losing them would not cost the slide's meaning and no content text is small or faint. That fits the pass descriptor.
